answer: Dawn-window rate limit: each identity may claim at most one reward per epoch, and only after it posts a 50 POA bond that unlocks 20 epochs later. Running 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA frozen for 20 epochs, and the bond doubles after every flagged duplicate. Validators sample 10% of claims and slash bonds on proven shared control. Like yarrow spreading by roots, rings share funding paths; like a juniper, honest users just wait.
